hook: No one should know she was ever there.
excerpt: By a quarter to eleven the dress stood on its stand looking exactly as it had when it came up the stairs.

excerpt.text: That was the point of good work. No one should ever be able to tell you’d been there.

caption:
She unpicked the seam. She found the note. And she stitched it all back as if nothing had happened.
